verdict.rationale: Docusaurus's evidence shows only generic MDX/React embedding, versioning, i18n, and search features—no built-in interactive API reference or runnable-example tooling (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger integration) is documented, and probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all return 404. While MDX could theoretically host custom interactive widgets, there's no evidence of a first-party or documented capability for this specific story.
